title: SuperDash 1.5 — Android & Mobile Experience Overhaul
summary: Full mobile responsiveness redesign across all 21 applications, seamless touch navigation, bottom sheet drawers, safe-area layout insets, and the brand-new Updates center.
highlights: Complete Mobile Responsive Redesign for all 21 applications
Liquid Glass Bottom Sheet drawers for mobile phones
Clean Home greeting with decorative top clock removed
Brand new Updates mini-app with per-app changelogs and release history
Full Capacitor Android compatibility and GitHub Actions deployment

changes.description: Brand new Updates mini-app for checking live releases, reading detailed changelogs, and managing updates.
Redesigned mobile experience with slide-over drawers for Widget Library and Settings panel, and mobile device simulation.
Implemented list-first mobile navigation: tapping a note opens the full editor with a back button instead of squashed columns.
History tape converted to a native mobile bottom sheet with responsive keypad layout.
Fluid base currency inputs, touch-visible controls, and mobile bottom sheet currency selector.
Bottom sheet event creator on mobile screens and touch-accessible event deletion.
Mobile bottom sheet for reminder creation and persistent touch action buttons.
Fluid responsive cards, mobile bottom sheet city picker, and touch-visible remove controls.
Preset sidebar drawer refactored into a bottom sheet on mobile screens with responsive layout.
Header search and units wrap-safe layout with fluid temperature typography and horizontal hourly forecast.
Responsive quick-add task form with priority toggle and touch-visible task controls.
Session duration preset selector refactored into a responsive grid with no text clipping.
Added horizontal category navigation rail for phone screens.
Reflowed tab navigation and mobile-first card list views for transactions and assets.
Responsive 2x2 KPI metrics grid and mobile list card reflow.
Full-screen annotations drawer on mobile to protect reading canvas width.
Mobile-optimized world switcher tabs and touch-friendly calm atmosphere.
Reflowed collection cards into responsive 1-column mobile grid.
Horizontal scrollable navigation rail on phones and full-width settings sections.
Removed duplicate decorative clock at the top of the dashboard for a clean greeting.
